messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The indexer relies on the product catalog for product documents, so if the product catalog is down the indexer is down. [valid 2025-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-30]
- As of 2026-05-29, Oskar is on the Ember team on-call rotation as the primary on-call. [valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-15, Oskar is off the Ember team on-call rotation. [valid 2026-01-15 to 2026-05-29; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-15]
- As of 2026-05-29, Oskar is the primary on-call for the Ember team, taking over from Diego. [valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-15, Diego is the primary on-call for the Ember team. [valid 2026-01-15 to 2026-05-29; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-15]
- As of 2025-11-27, Yuki Tanaka holds the Cinder pager, taking over from Diego, who is leaving the team. [valid 2025-11-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-11-27]
    earlier: As of 2025-10-24, Diego holds the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Yuki Tanaka. [valid 2025-10-24 to 2025-11-27; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-10-24]
- As of 2026-01-16, Tomasz is off the Dune team on-call rotation. [valid 2026-01-16 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-01-16]
- As of 2026-05-29, Diego is off the Ember team on-call rotation. [valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
- As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team still owns the reporting service. [valid 2026-04-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-13-2]
- Oskar takes the first on-call shift of the year for the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-14 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-14]
- Priya Raman holds the first on-call rotation for the Atlas team as of 2025-07-30. [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
    earlier: Tomasz has the first on-call rotation for the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-09]
- On 2026-06-09 the Dune team observed that the indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. [valid 2026-06-09 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-06-09]
- As of 2026-04-01, the pager for the indexer rings the Boreal team, not the Atlas team. [valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
- As of 2025-11-24, the Atlas team owns the bus, having taken it over from the Boreal team. [valid 2025-11-24 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-24-event-bus]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-15, the Boreal team still owns the bus. [valid 2025-08-15 to 2025-11-24; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-08-15-2]
- The indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11 until the full reindex completes. [constraint; valid 2025-04-22 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-22]
- On 2026-02-10 the Boreal team noticed that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-02-10 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-02-10-2]
- On 2026-05-27 the Atlas team noticed that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- On 2026-04-01, ownership of the indexer transferred from the Atlas team to the Boreal team. [valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
- On 2025-09-02 the Atlas team decided that clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds. [decision; valid 2025-09-02 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-02]
- In INC-2025-023, the indexer served stale results for two days starting 2025-10-03 because a reindex job failed silently on a full disk. [valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- On 2025-12-18 the Atlas team decided that the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every product catalog write, because incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes. [decision; valid 2025-12-18 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-18]
- As of 2025-09-04, Tomasz holds the Dune team on-call shift, taking over from Farah. [valid 2025-09-04 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-04]
    earlier: Farah has the first on-call rotation for the Dune team. [valid 2025-01-13 to 2025-09-04; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-13]
